top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 physiology and identification of its active form (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) is a mature, practice-changing discovery with clear clinical validation in type 2 diabetes and obesity; the three-laureate allocation with a citation scoped to physiology and the active peptide form is defensible and keeps the award to the foundational discoveries, so awarding is clearly preferable to no award.
